work.attention.title: What needs you
work.attention.hint: Nothing here clears itself. A row acts where one press is safe and says what it does; the rest open where they are answered.
work.attention.setUpShown: Shown in `{{environment}}`; it said nothing of what it showed.
work.attention.allowedRule: Allowed: {{change}}. Sessions started from now on are handed it.
work.attention.ask.approve: Every session on ask #{{id}} is handed your yes for this act at its next start.
work.attention.ask.refuse: Every session on ask #{{id}} is handed your no at its next start, and one that asks for this act again is told not to do it.
work.attention.ask.acceptRule: It widens what agents may do: {{change}}. Sessions started from now on are handed it.
work.attention.ask.choose: Publish it to a repository workspace {{workspace}} can ask.
work.attention.unanswerableWhy: `{{repository}}` is not on this deployment's register, so no agent will ever pull this quest.
work.attention.needsApp: What needs you is judged by the Daoris app: open the app to see what waits for your word.
work.attention.proposalWhy: The declarations propose {{repositories}}. Nothing is published until you choose.
work.attention.proposalNobody: No repository's declarations share its words. Name the receiver.
work.attention.trustWhy: The agent ignores this folder's own permissions.allow until you trust it there, so the driver is holding what would run in it.
work.attention.rule: an agent asks to do more
work.attention.accounts.noAccount: No Daoris account is signed in for {{product}}, so its starts wait until you sign in.
work.attention.signedOut.refused: Key refused: put a new API key into it on {{product}}'s page.
work.attention.helper: an agent asks for a helper
work.attention.helperWhy: {{session}} asked for another agent’s help. Nothing is asked until you let it.
work.attention.helperEndedWhy: {{session}} waited on its helper, which ended without an answer. Daoris could not bring it back to you, because the service refused: {{words}} It keeps its tree until you look at it.
work.attention.hand-over: an agent asks to hand over
work.attention.quietWhy: {{session}} has said nothing for {{minutes}} minutes, and nothing it runs uses the machine.
work.attention.quietBusyWhy: {{session}} has said nothing for {{minutes}} minutes, while something it runs keeps the machine busy.
work.attention.quietWords: Your words wait to reach it. Ending it hands them to the work’s next part.
work.attention.quietHeavy: It waits for the heavy run behind {{holder}}.
work.attention.quietHeavyTerminal: It waits for the heavy run behind a run started from a terminal.
work.attention.quietStopped: Its run is stopped, and its work waits for you.
work.attention.quietCarried: Its run ends, and the work goes on in the same tree at the next look.
work.attention.quietLeft: Left running: Daoris looks in again once it is heard from.
work.attention.quietGone: It is not quiet now: nothing was changed.
work.attention.ask.carryOn: This part ends as your stop, released at once: the work carries on in a new part in the same tree at the next look, handed Daoris’s brief. It is not counted as a failed session.
work.attention.ask.quietStop: Its run ends as your stop, and its quest waits for your Try again.
work.attention.ask.quietStopIntake: Its run ends as your stop, and its ask is left to you.
work.attention.handOverWhy: Its agent asks to hand {{session}} over to {{agent}}. Nothing goes until you say yes.
work.attention.permissionWhy: {{session}} waits on your answer before this tool call runs; it is refused if nobody answers within {{minutes}} minutes.
work.attention.permissionWhyUnbounded: {{session}} waits on your answer before this tool call runs; it is refused if nobody answers in time.
work.attention.answerWhy: {{agent}}’s answer would take this work on a third time with nobody between. It waits for you.
work.attention.answerWhySomeone: Another agent’s answer would take this work on a third time with nobody between. It waits for you.
work.attention.confirmationWhy: It runs only once you confirm it on its card in Notifications; it waits until you answer.
work.attention.spaceFloor: Below the floor of {{floor}} Daoris keeps free.
work.attention.spaceFreed: Daoris freed {{size}} of what it can make again; the rest is yours to choose.
work.attention.spaceFreedNothing: Daoris found nothing it can make again to free; the rest is yours to choose.
work.attention.spaceCould: Free up space… could free about {{size}} more.
work.attention.staleWhy: Stale for {{span}}: no session on ask #{{id}} runs or waits, and none of its quests is open.
work.attention.staleWhyUndated: Stale: no session on ask #{{id}} runs or waits, and none of its quests is open.
work.attention.ask.refuseStale: It is refused on ask #{{id}}, and nothing runs: no session waits for it, so none goes on. A later session on the ask is handed your no.
work.attention.stale.lead: {{count}} go-ahead is stale: nothing on its ask waits for it.
work.attention.stale.lead_other: {{count}} go-aheads are stale: nothing on their asks waits for them.
work.attention.stale.ask: Each is refused on its own ask with the reason below, as its own Refuse would be: no session is sent on, and nothing runs. A later session on one of these asks is handed your no.
work.attention.gitHeld.title.refused: {{host}} refused the sign-in git has here
work.attention.gitHeld.title.write-refus: {{host}} refused a push with the sign-in git has here
work.attention.gitHeld.title.host-unknow: ssh does not know {{host}}'s key yet
work.attention.gitHeld.title.host-change: {{host}}'s key changed since ssh last trusted it
work.attention.gitHeld.title.own-input: {{host}} is reached by the repository's own ssh command, past Daoris's door
work.attention.gitHeld.detail: {{repositories}}: Daoris does not try this git remote again until you press Try again, or its address or the git Daoris runs changes. git said: {{words}}
work.attention.gitHeld.detailOwnInput: {{repositories}}: the repository names its own ssh command (core.sshCommand), which git runs in place of Daoris's ssh door on this install, since the install's folder holds a space. Daoris does not reach this git remote until that setting is removed from the repository.
work.attention.gitHeld.lifted: Daoris tries {{host}} again for {{count}} repository the next time it needs it.
work.attention.gitHeld.lifted_other: Daoris tries {{host}} again for {{count}} repositories the next time it needs them.
work.attention.gitHeld.liftedNone: Daoris was no longer waiting on {{host}}: it tries it the next time it needs it.
